name: Facet
text: Choose a single high-contrast dark theme as default with adjustable saturation. This maximizes visibility and reduces eye strain in low light, aligning with our goal of clarity and enjoyment. The trade-off is aesthetic uniformity—some users may prefer lighter themes—but the data shows dark interfaces perform better for interactive data visualization. Adjustable saturation lets users personalize without sacrificing core usability.

name: Pane
text: Pane: One high-contrast dark theme still locks out users who need light mode for accessibility or migraines—no toggle means permanent exclusion. A better alternative: default dark with a persistent, one-click light mode toggle that remembers user choice. Settle it by testing both modes with users who have light-mode needs and measuring task completion time and comfort.
